item.title: From Card Enthusiast to Architect: A Philosophy of Life-Driven System Design
item.description: 1. Introduction: What is a Card Enthusiast? Let’s start with something I once saw online—the seven favorite hobbies of card enthusiasts: Note: “Mainland China” here refers to regions where capital inflow and outflow are restricted.
